summary: fractal-web removes closed-inspector reads and redundant pane suspense from seat switches and shows waiting roster geometry. The live socket owns initial roster delivery; a bounded published roster is read only after transport failure or a three-second first-snapshot stall, never as a parallel bootstrap

replay.detail: Client-only changes introduce no store replay or runtime recovery wait. Conversation and roster observations remain memory-only.

schema.detail: No database changes, wire schema additions, or generated-client changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or retention rules change.

compatibility.detail: The SDK exposes a bounded read through the existing agentsList endpoint, without fresh=true, and reuses the collections discovery probe. The app marks its HTTP publication stale until a collection frame is observed; late publications cannot replace live data. A page with has_more=true carries explicit partial coverage and a fixed partial-roster notice until live data arrives; the app does not fetch additional bootstrap pages. Earlier daemons retain the same endpoint but may still fold inline, so the latency benefit depends on the published-roster server changes. Scripted gateway tests cover publication-first, partial coverage, late response, absent publication and read refusal including live-first then refusal, not a deployed daemon/client pair.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption is introduced by these app changes. No deployed latency or restart timing was measured.

manual.detail: For cheap published-roster reads, the serving daemon must include the publication and replica-readiness changes merged at ca8a73622. The chunked-card optimization in 0ebd0f7d1, merged at 8cd4e4c06, further reduces cold publication cost. Main at 164bdff6f includes both. This app layer does not update or restart that daemon.

recovery.detail: No durable migration; replacing or reloading the app drops its memory-only observations and reads them again. A cold daemon with no published roster still waits for its real collection data rather than rendering an empty roster.
